title: Explicit full-dimensional Julia set
exact_target: Give an explicit rational Julia set of dimension two, and identify a natural geometric measure for such sets when their ordinary area is zero.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5300045 (AMR-052-0045). CC BY 4.0.
Mikhail Lyubich, ``Measure and Dimension of Julia Sets'', in Ben Bielefeld and Mikhail Lyubich (eds.), Problems in Holomorphic Dynamics (1992), Problem 5, pp. 27; arXiv:math/9205209v1.
